claim.claim-text: 1. A light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600), characterized by, comprising:

2. The light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600) according to claim 1, characterized in that, the output lights in the second state (SU2) are uniformly scattered within an observable viewing angle.

3. The light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600) according to any one of claims 1 to 2, characterized in that, the light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600) further comprises a first electrode (E1) and a second electrode (E2), wherein the light controller (130) is disposed between the first electrode (E1) and the second electrode (E2).

4. The light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600) according to claim 3, characterized in that, the light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600) further comprises a plurality of peripheral traces (PT) respectively connected to the first electrode (E1) and the second electrode (E2).

5. The light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600) according to any one of claims 3 to 4, characterized in that, the first electrode (E1) and the second electrode (E2) comprise a transparent conductive material.
6. The light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600) according to claim 5, characterized in that, the first electrode (E1) and the second electrode (E2) comprise indium tin oxide.

7. The light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600) according to any one of claims 3 to 6, characterized in that, at least one of the first electrode (E1) and the second electrode (E2) is patterned.

8. The light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600) according to any one of claims 1 to 7, characterized in that, the light controller (130) comprises a wall (134 or 534) configured to filter the lights.

9. The light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600) according to claim 8, characterized in that, the light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600) further comprises an illuminating surface (LS), wherein an angle between a side wall (134a or 534a) of the wall (134 or 534) and the illuminating surface (LS) is greater than or equal to 80°.

10. The light emitting device (100, 200, 300 or 400) according to any one of claims 1 to 9, characterized in that, the light controller (130) comprises at least one switchable diffuser (132), the lights pass through the at least one switchable diffuser (132) to form the output lights, and the at least one switchable diffuser (132) is switched to make the light controller (130) switchable in the first state (SU1) and the second state (SU2).

11. The light emitting device (400) according to claim 10, characterized in that, the light controller (130) comprises two layers, one of the layers is a collimator (410), and the other layer is the at least one switchable diffuser (132) disposed on the collimator (410).

12. The light emitting device (100, 200, 300 or 400) according to any one of claims 1 to 7, characterized in that, the light controller (130) comprises a plurality of switchable diffusers (132) disposed corresponding to the light emitting elements (120) and a plurality of light shielding elements (134) surrounding the plurality of switchable diffusers (132).
13. The light emitting device (200) according to claim 12, characterized in that, the light emitting device (200) further comprises:

14. The light emitting device (500 or 600) according to any one of claims 1 to 7, characterized in that, the light controller (130) comprises a plurality of cells (532) disposed corresponding to the light emitting elements (120) and a plurality of switchable walls (534) surrounding the cells (532), and the plurality of switchable walls (534) are switched to make the light controller (130) switchable in the first state (SU1) and the second state (SU2).

15. The light emitting device (100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600) according to any one of claims 1 to 14, characterized in that, the sum of the intensity of the output lights in the second state (SU2) in the angle ranged from 80° to 100° is less than 80% of a total intensity of the output lights in the second state (SU2).
